Hi Daniel —

Really helpful questions. High level responses below; I can package this into one-pager options for CFO review tomorrow.

A) Mid-contract tier rebucket (Starter -> Growth)- Proration: we support monthly pro rata credit for unused tokens/seats. If you move teams up, you'll be invoiced the delta pro rata for the remainder of the billing period. Moving down is more nuanced (see guardrails below).
- Seat reallocation: yes — seats are transferrable within the same legal entity. We can also pool seats under a single seat pool for a smoother migration.

B) Phased add-on rollout (real-time reranking)- Pilot mode (subset of teams): we can enable the add-on for a pilot cohort and meter usage separately while granting a temporary pilot discount. Billing model: flat pilot fee + usage overage (per 1k requests). After full rollout we either fold into Growth tier or keep as separate add-on depending on adoption.

C) Down-moves and guardrails- Downgrades between tiers: allowed at renewal windows only by default. For mid-contract downgrades we offer a credit schedule tied to utilization thresholds (we can draft a conservative credit ladder).

Next step: I’ll run numbers with Karthik and Lauren and share a short options table + a draft amendment (we can reference DocuSign if procurement wants a fast sign).

Talk soon,

Subject: Internal: MediSpan — proposal framing for CFO (prorate/credits/phasing)

Team —

Recap: MediSpan wants (1) a route to move two teams Starter->Growth mid-contract, (2) a phased rollout of reranking as an add-on with hybrid billing, and (3) clarity on downgrade guardrails.

My suggested approach (fast, low friction):
- Option A (Conservative): Mid-contract upgrade allowed; invoice pro rata delta immediately. No mid-contract downgrade — must wait to renewal. Pilot add-on as flat pilot fee + metered overage; if they expand, convert to Growth add-on pricing.
- Option B (Commercial): Offer a small upgrade credit (5–10%) applied when they upgrade mid-period if they commit to a 9–12 month minimum on the Growth tier post-upgrade. For the pilot, give 30% pilot discount on flat fee for one quarter.
- Option C (Strategic): For enterprise conversion, allow a mid-contract downgrade with partial credit ladder (50/30/10 across quarters) if they buy a guaranteed seat pool and commit to a minimum annual usage.

Numbers: I started a model in the attached sheet (pricing-model.xlsx) with scenarios for a 3-team vs 5-team rollout. Karthik — can you validate the credit ladder math and run a short capacity check for Growth tier in us-west for Q3 ramp? Ben/Lauren — thoughts on legal language for a short amendment (we want simple language: "mid-contract upgrades allowed; downgrades subject to credit ladder and renewal windows").

Thanks — hoping to get a version to Daniel by Friday.

Olga

Hi Daniel / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attached are two items: a scenario workbook (pricing-model.xlsx) and a short draft amendment (draft-amendment.pdf) that captures the mechanics. Below is an executive summary and three recommended options you can show the CFO.

Executive summary:
- We can enable a phased pilot for the reranking add-on for Q3 with a pilot price (flat fee $6k/month) + metered per-1k request overage. Pilot discount: 30% for the first quarter.
- Mid-contract upgrade: allowed immediately; billing = pro rata invoice for Growth tier delta for remainder of the billing period.
- Mid-contract downgrade: by default only at renewal. If you need a mid-term downgrade we can offer a credit ladder tied to usage and a minimum post-upgrade commitment (see Option B).

Options table (high level):
- Option 1 (Low-friction): Immediate upgrade, no downgrade until renewal. Pilot add-on at 30% off for Q3, then convert or keep as add-on at standard rates.
- Option 2 (Balanced): 7% upgrade credit when upgrading mid-term if MediSpan commits to 9 months on Growth post-upgrade. Pilot add-on as above with 30% pilot discount.
- Option 3 (Enterprise): Allow mid-term downgrade with staggered credit (50/30/10) across three quarters if MediSpan purchases a 12-month seat pool and minimum monthly usage commitment. Pilot add-on discounted and convertible to included feature at agreed adoption thresholds.

Ask: Please review the attached workbook and amendment. If Option 2 is appealing, procurement can approve a short DocuSign amendment and we’ll schedule an onboarding window next month. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Start/EDU-MSP-2026
